tasks.brief:
Implementation constraints: synchronous DOM manipulation, no async/await, no external libraries. Edit exactly one line in highlightSearchHits().

Behavioral specification: In src/static/threads.js, locate the highlightSearchHits() function. Find the exact line:
`hitElements = document.querySelectorAll('mark.search-hit');`
Replace it with:
`hitElements = Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('mark.search-hit'), function (m) { return m.getClientRects().length > 0; });`
Nothing else in the file changes. hitElements is already used only via .length and index access, which arrays support.

Acceptance: grep -q 'getClientRects' src/static/threads.js && grep -q 'window.Threads' src/static/threads.js
